precedence: this contract governs state, action, writer, and call-journal semantics

query_clock.event_effective: event.valid_from <= cut.valid_time AND (event.valid_to_or_null == null OR cut.valid_time < event.valid_to_or_null)
query_clock.retroactive_correction: attach to the visible chain head at knowledge_time; retain the event validity interval; current value is the first visible, effective, unretracted node found by walking parent links from the visible head
query_clock.prior_cut_rule: an event observed after a prior cut never changes that prior cut

serialization.larger_integer_rule: canonical unsigned decimal string with regex ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$
serialization.time_format: RFC3339 UTC with exactly six fractional digits and suffix Z
serialization.array_order: semantic ID UTF8-bytewise ascending unless journal_seq order is explicitly required

base_event.duplicate_result: DUPLICATE_NOOP within the exact idempotency identity only
global_guards: journal_seq is a positive contiguous safe integer assigned only by the writer
all references exist unless this event creates the reference
every source_event_id precedes the new journal_seq
payload is valid for the named event type

state.fact_chain: one parent-linked chain; no sibling branch or cycle
state.fact_current_rule: from the visible chain head, walk parent links and return the first visible, effective, unretracted version; otherwise no value

derived_sets.O_blocked: lifecycle == OPEN AND at least one prerequisite is not COMPLETED
derived_sets.O_due: lifecycle == OPEN AND due_at <= cut.valid_time AND not O_blocked

state.scope_rule: scope_id is immutable; delegation changes owner_role only; dependencies and handoffs are same-scope

correct_fact.effect: append child fact version to visible chain head; reject cycle or sibling

retract_fact.effect: mark named visible version retracted; parent walk determines current

complete_obligation.guard: OPEN and O_due and payload completion_action_id equals obligation.completion_action_id

reopen_obligation.effect: set OPEN, new due/owner, clear terminal, retain prerequisites

open_handoff.effect: create OPEN handoff for one OPEN target obligation

record_call_response.guard: key has no accepted response; response_ref identifies immutable bytes; response_hash matches
record_call_response.effect: append accepted bytes before parse; every recovery reuses these bytes and never resamples

propose_handoff_result.effect: set PROPOSED after schema, scope, hash, availability, and transition validation

commit_handoff_result.effect: execute ordered actions through action_executor atomically, then set COMMITTED

reject_handoff_result.effect: append no proposed mutation; set REJECTED with one frozen code

close_handoff.effect: set CLOSED from COMMITTED or REJECTED

action_universe.available: NO_ACTION plus one ACT for every obligation with any visible lifecycle event
action_universe.gold: all mounted critical obligations in O_due, else NO_ACTION

ACT_ON_OBLIGATION.journal_assignment: writer assigns one contiguous journal_seq per child event before terminal commit event
ACT_ON_OBLIGATION.atomicity: validate every child first; append all children plus commit terminal or append none

writer.invalid_proposal_rule: do not append propose_handoff_result and do not attempt an illegal transition
writer.commit_rule: validate entire ordered action set, construct exact child events, atomically append children then commit terminal
writer.replay_rule: same proposal idempotency identity yields one semantic effect

paid_handoff_gold.eligibility: exactly one mounted critical O_due obligation and at least one non-gold available action
paid_handoff_gold.A1_gold: recompute after deterministic writer terminal; committed target cannot recur

mandatory_enumerator.pair_fixture_rule: every load-bearing pair acts on the same entity and declares exact pre-state, first result, intermediate state, second result, and final state
